the development and exploitation of a new class of yeast strain for use in the industrial production of recombinant proteins.

strains with reduced carboxypetidase and/or proteinase A activity show the highest levels of heterologous gene expression.

the vacuolar protein degradation pathway can have a significant negative effect on the production of recombinant proteins in S. cerevisiae.
